description: This Java source file defines the 'CustomPermissivePolicy' class, which implements a custom HTML sanitizer policy based on OWASP standards. The class provides a policy object, 'POLICY_DEFINITION', that specifies allowed HTML tags, attributes, and URL protocols for sanitizing HTML input to prevent XSS vulnerabilities.

classes.name: CustomPermissivePolicy
classes.description: A class providing a custom HTML sanitization policy that permits certain tags and attributes to mitigate XSS while allowing rich HTML content.

methods.name: getSanitizerPolicy
methods.description: Returns the predefined HTML sanitization policy object used to sanitize HTML content.
